sections.label: Experiment
sections.description: Select a type of experiment. After selecting the experiment type you can select a setup-type.

sections.label: File type
sections.description: After selecting a setup-type adjust the parameters of the setup used to open the experimental data.

sections.label: Add as
sections.description: How data read here or dropped on the window enters the project: linked (the file stays where it is; its path, size and checksum are recorded, so the project stays small) or embedded (copied into the project file at the next save, so the project is complete on its own). Right-click a dataset in Datasets to switch it later.

sections.label: File
sections.description: The file to read. Drop a file onto the window, type its path or browse for it.

buttons.label: Load example
buttons.description: Write a correlation curve whose answer is known (one diffusing species, N = 2, τD = 0.5 ms) and select it with the FCS file type.

buttons.label: + Data
buttons.description: Read the file with the selected file type and add it to the datasets.
